findings.title: Over/Under line extraction brittleness
findings.description: _extract_line() in settlement.py uses regex (\d+)[_.](\d+) which assumes line format like 'OVER_2_5' or 'OVER_2.5'. If a market identifier uses a different pattern (e.g., 'OVER2.5' with no separator, or 'OVER_TWO_HALF'), extraction fails with ValueError. Add fallback patterns or validate market identifiers at prediction creation time.

findings.title: Handicap extraction assumes specific format
findings.description: _extract_handicap() splits on underscore and looks for parts starting with +/-. Format like 'HANDICAP-1.5HOME' (no underscores) or 'HOME_HANDICAP_-1.5' (reversed order) would fail. This may not occur with current Smart Market Selector output, but the parser is fragile.

findings.title: No test for settlement frozen pick integrity
findings.description: Test suite in test_settlement.py covers all market types and void scenarios but doesn't verify that settle_prediction() never modifies the nine frozen pick fields. The verification.md claims this was tested, but no test exists in the code. Add a test that creates a version with frozen pick, settles it, and asserts all nine fields remain unchanged.

findings.title: win_rate returns 0.0 instead of None for empty datasets
findings.description: get_settled_summary() returns win_rate = 0.0 when non_void == 0, but comment/docstring intent suggests None to distinguish 'no data' from '0% win rate'. Current code treats them the same. This is minor but could confuse consumers expecting None for empty datasets.
